hook: This product has no test report yet. It says so on the page.
hypothesis: Advertising the absence of data outperforms asserting quality, because it is the one thing in this category a viewer cannot assume is marketing. Disproved if view-through holds but CTR to /coa-library is at or below the offer-led control — that would mean the honesty reads as a weakness rather than a reason to look.
opening_frame: Macro, dark field: the printed lower half of a vial label, so close that only the small print is legible. No logo, no wordmark, no title card. It is already moving — a slow lateral drift begins on frame one.

script.spoken: This product has no test report yet.
The site says so, on the product page, in writing.
Reports are filed per batch, not per product. A product without one is marked pending rather than given a placeholder figure.
That is the whole policy. Read it yourself.

shot_list.shot: MACRO, slow lateral drift. Lower half of the printed label, small print legible, glass curve catching one thin highlight. Dark field falling to black at the edges.
MEDIUM, locked off. The single vial upright on a matte charcoal plinth, lit from behind, soft contact shadow. Text sets in the empty field beside it, never over the label.
SCREEN CAPTURE, real. The live COA library page scrolling slowly to the 'About our testing' section, captured at device resolution, no mockup frame, no device bezel.
MEDIUM WIDE, slow pull back. Vial small in frame, generous negative space, CTA line in the lower-middle third above the platform UI band.

visual_direction: Dark matte laboratory per brand.md. Background #0a0a0a, pure neutral, no blue tint. Gold #c7ae5e held to roughly 8% of frame — a thin edge highlight on the crimp seal and the CTA rule only, never a filled shape. Glass, not gold. Motion 200-350ms eased, no whip transitions, no bounce. Frame edges fall away to black rather than ending in a hard rectangle.

on_screen_text.note: Manrope, sentence-height caps, centred in negative space right of the vial. Clear of top 12% and bottom 20%; never overlapping the printed label.
Lower-middle third, left-aligned to the screen capture.
Fraunces 500, tight tracking. Sits above the bottom 20% band.

on_screen_text.text: For laboratory research use only. Not for human consumption.
on_screen_text.note: Persistent, Manrope, muted #a3a3a3, single instance only, above the bottom 20% safe area.

voiceover: Male or female, level and unhurried, close-mic, no music bed under the first two seconds. Reads as a statement of policy, not a pitch. No upward inflection on the final line.
caption: we publish the report when there is a report. until then the page says pending.
audience: Cold. Buyers who have been burned by a supplier claiming purity with nothing behind it, and who evaluate a site by whether it will admit a gap.
